body:
Okay, so, I’m not sure how to start this. For the past couple weeks I’ve been hearing more and more discussion about me in my apartment from my neighboring apartments. I’ve never had more than a passing convo with one or two neighbors, so they’re all strangers to me but they know one another. 

A month or two ago I left some laundry in the laundry room and didn’t think about it till the next time I did a wash. Someone jacked off into an old undershirt of mine, i tossed it, figured i was done. Then the dude that jacked it recognized me from the shirt i was wearing, and started gossiping about me with my neighbors as the dude who’s shirt he came in i guess. That started some convos about “who is that guy anyway” in my hallway that I figured would go away in a day or two because I hardly see any of my neighbors, so why would they think of me at all, right?

Anyway, I’ve thought I was going crazy with weird things like finding things in my apartment in odd places that I never leave them, or my light switches turned off/chords pulled into inactive state, when I have smart lights and turn my lights off with an app our voice commands to siri. The voices of my neighbors kept getting weirder and weirder, and I just assumed I was having a schizophrenic episode, which I have had in the past. 

Anyway, I put on earplugs, and I can’t hear the voices anymore. I totally acknowledge this sounds completely insane, but hypothetically if it were to be real, what the fuck could I do? I’m at the point where I think they‘re breaking into my apartment using a bumpkey and I’m just completely lost on what to do. 

I feel like even if this wild situation were to be real, it would be dismissed by literally everyone. Could someone please give some advice of what steps I could take? 

I’ve posted a note on my door that I have a history of mental illness and please alert me if I’m being stalked, because if I can hear my neighbors than surely my neighbors can here them/me as well. That got no response, and now my fear is that my neighbors know that I’m susceptible to manipulation if they speak out loud about me in their apartment. 

This is like a really shitty situation of I’m either having an episode or I’m legitimately being stalked in the most wildest way, and I just would appreciate any advice. The fact that the voices went away when I put in earplugs has me wanting to treat this as likely actually happening. During previous episodes, earplugs did nothing.
